Title: Enhancing the Ability of Consumers To Control the Robocalls
Action: Final rule.
Abstract: In this document, the Federal Communications Commission (Commission) modifies rules to ensure that consumers can revoke consent for robocalls they no longer wish to receive while continuing to receive those they still want.
